bar_placeholder: Ask the lead, describe a goal, or create a ticket…
bar_label: A ticket title, a goal or a question for the lead
bar_body_label: The ticket's description and its acceptance criteria
ticket_failed: The ticket was not created. Try again.
needs_empty: Nothing waits for you. A permission, a question or a release shows here when a session needs you.

release_unreviewed_red: A check failed, not reviewed yet.
permission_paused: The author is paused until you answer.
question_paused: The session is paused until you answer.
question_lead: The lead waits for your answer on its screen.

plan_proposes_cost_one: The lead proposes {n} ticket, about {time} of work, about ${cost}.
plan_proposes_cost_other: The lead proposes {n} tickets, about {time} of work, about ${cost}.
live_empty: No session is running. A ticket in Todo starts one.
lead_no_line: No message from the lead yet.
lead_message_label: A message for the lead, finished on its screen
plans_empty: No plan in progress. Give the lead a goal from the bar above.
